articles.title: Centrica shares jump 2% as Jefferies sees overlooked business growth
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Centrica shares jumped more than 2% on Tuesday after Jefferies upgraded the British utility to "buy" from "hold" and raised its price target to 200 pence from 190 pence, saying the market is overlooking growth in its retail and infrastructure businesses, which account for about 85% of its expected 2027 EBITDA.
